(কাস্টমস)

প্রজ্ঞাপন

তারিখ: ১৯ ফাল্গুন, ১৪৩১ বঙ্গাব্দ/০৪ মার্চ, ২০২৫ খ্রিষ্টাব্দ

এস.আর.ও. নং ৭৭-আইন/২০২৫/০৫/কাস্টমস—সরকার, কাস্টমস আইন, ২০২৩ (২০২৩ সনের ৫৭ নং আইন) এর ধারা ২৬৩ এর উপ-ধারা (১) এ প্রদত্ত ক্ষমতাবলে, নিম্নরূপ বিধিমালা প্রণয়ন করিল, যথা:—

Customs Act 2023: Section 263(1) of this Act serves as the legal authority empowering the government to formulate and enact customs rules.
National Board of Revenue: The National Board of Revenue is the regulatory authority identified as the issuing body for these customs notifications and rules.
Customs Risk Management Rules 2025: These rules are formally enacted under the specific provisions of the Customs Act 2023 to establish a procedural framework for risk management in customs operations.

processed_clauses.resolved_text:
১। শিরোনাম ও প্রবর্তন।—(১) এই বিধিমালা কাস্টমস ঝুঁকি ব্যবস্থাপনা বিধিমালা, ২০২৫ নামে অভিহিত হইবে।
(২) ইহা অবিলম্বে কার্যকর হইবে।

Customs Risk Management Rules 2025: These rules are officially designated as the Customs Risk Management Rules 2025.
The provisions of these rules come into effect immediately upon their publication.

Economic Risk: This is defined as risks related to money laundering, terror financing, proceeds of crime, illegal financial activities, evasion of customs duties and taxes, and trans-national organized economic crime.
Customs Act 2023: Referred to as the Act, this is the primary legislation governing these rules.
Yellow Lane: A selectivity lane in the automated system designated for reviewing documents without requiring physical examination of the goods.
Data Analytics: A method involving the collection, examination, audit, cleansing, and modeling of digital or analog data for the purpose of risk identification and decision-making.
Customs Risk Management Commissionerate: An entity established by the National Board of Revenue for the management of customs risks and implementation of risk management strategies.
Green Channel: A designated passage at entry points for arriving passengers who are not carrying goods subject to customs duties or taxes.
Green Lane: A selectivity lane in the automated system where goods are cleared without document verification, physical examination, or other risk mitigation procedures.
Goods Declaration: Refers to manifests, import or export declarations, and any other information regarding goods or passengers submitted by a person or agent to the customs authority.
Declarant: A person or licensed agent responsible for the clearance of goods, who is liable for the accuracy of all information and documents submitted in a declaration.
Risk: Defined as economic risks and the potential for violation of the Act or any other customs-related laws, rules, or orders during the clearance of goods.
Risk Indicator: Specific criteria used to select and identify high-risk goods consignments or passengers.
Risk Identification: The process of identifying and listing potential risk areas based on information obtained from various sources under risk management protocols.
Risk Assessment: The process of determining the impact, intensity, and likelihood of potential risks through the analysis of identified risk areas.
Risk Management: The lawful activities conducted by the Customs Risk Management Commissionerate to identify, analyze, determine, assess, and control risk areas.
Documents: Defined as any information stored in physical, electronic, or any other medium.
Goods: Defined as per the meaning assigned in Section 2(30) of the Customs Act.
Consignment of Goods: Refers to goods imported, exported, transited, transshipped, or stored in a bonded warehouse, following prescribed methods and forms.
Clearance of Goods: The process of releasing goods from the control of customs authorities upon compliance with all necessary legal and procedural requirements.
Release of Goods: The action taken by customs to hand over goods to the appropriate person or agent after completion of assessment and payment of duties and taxes.
Profile: A collection and analysis system for risk indicators related to importers, exporters, agents, passengers, or goods to determine the appropriate lane (red, yellow, green, blue) or channel for clearance.
Person: Defined as per the meaning assigned in Section 2(39) of the Customs Act.
Blue Lane: A selectivity lane in the automated system where goods are cleared without immediate physical or document verification, pending post-clearance audit.
Manifest Data: Data obtained from vehicle and cargo declarations, Advance Passenger Information (API), Passenger Name Record (PNR), and reports related to inward/outward movement, transit, or transshipment.
Passenger: Defined to include both regular passengers and crew members.
Red Channel: A passage for arriving passengers at entry points who are carrying goods subject to customs duties, restricted goods, or prohibited items.
Red Lane: A selectivity lane in the automated system where selected consignments are subject to document verification and mandatory 100% physical examination.
Selectivity: A function performed by the automated system or manually by the Customs Risk Management Commissionerate to assign specific risk mitigation procedures to a consignment based on risk indicators or random selection.
Automated Risk Management System: An automated system operated by the Customs Risk Management Commissionerate that assesses the likelihood of risk for a consignment or passenger by comparing declaration data against predefined risk indicators.

processed_clauses.clause_title: কাস্টমস রিস্ক ম্যানেজমেন্ট কমিশনারেট (সিআরএমসি) এর ক্ষমতা ও কার্যাবলি

Customs Risk Management Commissionerate: The Customs Risk Management Commissionerate is responsible for collecting and analyzing risk data, establishing risk profiles, and implementing comprehensive risk management plans.
It manages the selectivity parameters for automated systems, maintains risk registers, and conducts research to provide policy recommendations to the National Board of Revenue.
The Commissionerate oversees risk management activities at customs stations, coordinates with international and national agencies, and ensures the protection of sensitive information.

It is empowered to collect necessary data from various government and financial institutions and may sign agreements or memoranda of understanding subject to the approval of the National Board of Revenue.
Risk Analysis: Risk analysis involves the systematic collection and evaluation of information to identify, classify, and mitigate risks associated with customs operations.
The process incorporates techniques like targeting intelligence, artificial intelligence, and data analytics to identify high and low-risk shipments or passengers.
Risk Management System: The automated risk management system facilitates the selectivity process for customs shipments, assigning them to different lanes such as green, blue, yellow, or red based on risk evaluation.
It serves as a central tool for monitoring, updating, and applying risk indicators to streamline customs clearance procedures.
Risk Register: A risk register is to be maintained as an online-based tool for documenting, updating, and storing identified risks related to customs activities.
Profile: Risk profiles are generated and subjected to periodic review, modification, and deletion to ensure they remain relevant to current customs risk trends.
National Board of Revenue: The National Board of Revenue receives performance reports, provides approval for official agreements, and exercises oversight over the activities of the Customs Risk Management Commissionerate.
Economic Risk: Economic risk is assessed by monitoring factors like tax rates, customs valuation, market conditions, and international trade agreements that influence customs operations.

processed_clauses.clause_title: কাস্টমস রিস্ক ম্যানেজমেন্ট কমিশনারেট ব্যতীত বোর্ডের অন্যান্য দপ্তর কর্তৃক ঝুঁকি ব্যবস্থাপনা পদ্ধতি
processed_clauses.resolved_text:
৪। কাস্টমস রিস্ক ম্যানেজমেন্ট কমিশনারেট ব্যতীত বোর্ডের অন্যান্য দপ্তর কর্তৃক ঝুঁকি ব্যবস্থাপনা পদ্ধতি।—(১) বোর্ডের অধীন কাস্টমস স্টেশন, মূসক কমিশনারেট, কাস্টমস গোয়েন্দা ও তদন্ত অধিদপ্তর, সেন্ট্রাল ইন্টেলিজেন্স সেল, কাস্টমস বন্ড কমিশনারেটসমূহ কোনো পণ্যচালানের বিষয়ে শুল্কায়নের পূর্বে ঝুঁকি সংক্রান্ত আগাম তথ্য প্রাপ্ত হইলে উহা এআরএমএস সফটওয়্যারে এন্ট্রি করিবে।
(২) পণ্যচালানের শুল্কায়ন সম্পন্ন হইবার পর উপ-বিধি (১) এ বর্ণিত কোনো তথ্য প্রাপ্ত হইলে সংশ্লিষ্ট কাস্টমস স্টেশন বা কাস্টমস গোয়েন্দা ও তদন্ত অধিদপ্তর বা সেন্ট্রাল ইন্টেলিজেন্স সেল তাৎক্ষণিকভাবে প্রতিরোধমূলক প্রয়োজনীয় ব্যবস্থা গ্রহণ করিবে এবং উক্ত ব্যবস্থার ফলাফল এআরএমএস সফটওয়্যারে এন্ট্রি করিবে।
(৩) যাত্রী সংশ্লিষ্ট ঝুঁকি সংক্রান্ত কোনো তথ্য প্রাপ্ত হইলে সংশ্লিষ্ট কাস্টমস স্টেশন বা কাস্টমস গোয়েন্দা ও তদন্ত অধিদপ্তর বা সেন্ট্রাল ইন্টেলিজেন্স সেল তাৎক্ষণিকভাবে প্রতিরোধমূলক প্রয়োজনীয় সকল ব্যবস্থা গ্রহণ করিবে এবং উক্ত ব্যবস্থার ফলাফল এআরএমএস সফটওয়্যারে এন্ট্রি করিবে।

National Board of Revenue: The Board oversees various departments that are responsible for implementing risk management procedures regarding customs consignments and passengers.
ARMS Software: This software serves as the central platform for recording risk-related information for cargo consignments and the outcomes of preventive actions taken by customs offices.
Customs offices and investigation units must input the results of any preventive measures taken regarding cargo or passengers directly into the ARMS software.
Customs Risk Management: Various customs departments, including customs stations, VAT commissionerates, intelligence cells, and bonding commissionerates, must document pre-clearance risk information in the designated system.
Upon identifying risk-related information after the customs clearance process for goods, the relevant departments are mandated to take immediate preventive actions and update the system accordingly.

In cases where risk-related information concerning passengers is discovered, the authorized customs departments must execute immediate preventive measures and record the results in the risk management software.
Customs Station: These stations are tasked with inputting advance risk information into the risk management software and carrying out preventive measures for both goods and passengers when necessary.
Customs Intelligence and Investigation D: This directorate is responsible for entering risk data into the software and initiating preventive actions against identified risks related to goods or passengers.
Central Intelligence Cell: The cell is required to record risk information regarding cargo and passengers in the risk management software and implement necessary preventive steps when such risks are identified.
Customs Bond Commissionerate: This office is mandated to input advance risk information concerning cargo consignments into the designated customs risk management system.
Value Added Tax Commissionerate: This department is responsible for recording advance risk information related to cargo consignments into the authorized risk management system.

Integrated Risk Management Committee: The National Board of Revenue is mandated to form a centralized Integrated Risk Management Committee to fulfill the objectives of the Customs Risk Management Rules 2025.

The committee is composed of various senior customs officials, including members of the customs wing, commissioners of customs stations, bond commissioners, the head of customs intelligence, and specific representatives from the risk management directorate.
The committee holds quarterly meetings to review customs risk management protocols.
National Board of Revenue: The Board acts as the authorizing body responsible for the establishment and composition of the Integrated Risk Management Committee.
Customs Risk Management Commissionerate: The Commissioner of this directorate serves as a core member of the Integrated Risk Management Committee, and its Additional or Joint Commissioner serves as the member secretary.

৬। সমন্বিত ঝুঁকি ব্যবস্থাপনা কমিটির কার্যপরিধি।—আইআরএমসি এর কার্যপরিধি হইবে নিম্নরূপ, যথা:—
(ক) কাস্টমস রিস্ক ম্যানেজমেন্ট কমিশনারেট কর্তৃক গৃহীত বার্ষিক কর্মপরিকল্পনা ও কার্যক্রমের অগ্রগতি পরিবীক্ষণ ও ঝুঁকি ব্যবস্থাপনা কার্যক্রম জোরদার করিবার লক্ষ্যে নীতিগত পরামর্শ প্রদান করা;
(খ) এআরএমএস বাস্তবায়নে অভিজ্ঞতালব্ধ দিক-নির্দেশনা প্রদান এবং কার্যকারিতা পর্যালোচনা করা; এবং
(গ) ঝুঁকি ব্যবস্থাপনা সংক্রান্ত সামগ্রিক কার্যক্রম পর্যালোচনা এবং ঝুঁকি ব্যবস্থাপনা পদ্ধতির আধুনিকায়নের প্রয়োজনীয় সুপারিশ প্রদান করা।

Integrated Risk Management Committee: The committee is responsible for monitoring the progress of the annual work plan and activities undertaken by the Customs Risk Management Commissionerate.
It provides strategic policy advice to strengthen risk management operations.
The committee offers guidance based on practical experience regarding the implementation of the Automated Risk Management System and reviews its overall effectiveness.
It is tasked with reviewing comprehensive risk management activities and making necessary recommendations for the modernization of risk management methodologies.
Customs Risk Management Commissionerate: This body is responsible for preparing and executing the annual work plan and operations related to risk management in customs processes.
Automated Risk Management System: The committee reviews the performance and implementation of this system to ensure it functions effectively within the customs framework.

processed_clauses.clause_title: স্বয়ংক্রিয় ঝুঁকি ব্যবস্থাপনা পদ্ধতি (Automated Risk Management System-এআরএমএস)
processed_clauses.resolved_text: ৭। স্বয়ংক্রিয় ঝুঁকি ব্যবস্থাপনা পদ্ধতি (Automated Risk Management System-এআরএমএস)।—যথাযর্থ কাস্টমস নিয়ন্ত্রণ প্রতিষ্ঠার উদ্দেশ্যে, কাস্টমস রিস্ক ম্যানেজমেন্ট কমিশনারেটে পণ্যচালান, যাত্রী, এজেন্ট ও ব্যাংক সংশ্লিষ্ট ঝুঁকি বিশ্লেষণপূর্বক সিলেক্টভিটি নিরূপণের লক্ষ্যে এআরএমএস অথবা উপযোগী স্বয়ংক্রিয় ইলেকট্রনিক সিস্টেম ব্যবহার করিবে।

Automated Risk Management System: The Customs Risk Management Commissionerate is mandated to utilize an Automated Risk Management System or an equivalent electronic system to conduct risk analysis.
The objective of using this system is to ensure effective customs control by performing risk analysis on consignments, passengers, agents, and banking transactions to determine selectivity.
Customs Risk Management Commissionerate: This body is responsible for managing customs risk by implementing automated systems to analyze various data points related to trade, passengers, and financial intermediaries for selectivity purposes.

৮। তথ্য-উপাত্ত সংগ্রহ ও বিশ্লেষণ।—(১) কাস্টমস কম্পিউটার সিস্টেম হইতে ঝুঁকি ব্যবস্থাপনার জন্য সংশ্লিষ্ট তথ্য-উপাত্ত কাস্টমস রিস্ক ম্যানেজমেন্ট কমিশনারেটে সংগ্রহ করিবে।
(২) বাংলাদেশের অভ্যন্তরীণ বা বাহির হইতে বা গোপন সংবাদদাতার মাধ্যমে প্রাপ্ত যেকোনো তথ্য উপাত্ত সংগ্রহ, বিশ্লেষণ ও প্রয়োজনে সরেজমিনে যাচাইপূর্বক সত্যতা নিশ্চিত হইয়া তাহা ঝুঁকি ব্যবস্থাপনার নির্ণায়ক হিসাবে ব্যবহার করিবে।
(৩) পণ্য চালান শুল্কায়ন পরবর্তীকালে কাস্টমস গোয়েন্দা ও তদন্ত অধিদপ্তর বা বাংলাদেশের যে কোনো কাস্টমস স্টেশন কর্তৃক আমদানি চালান বা রপ্তানি চালানে প্রাপ্ত অনিয়মের তথ্য বা উপাত্ত কাস্টমস রিস্ক ম্যানেজমেন্ট কমিশনারেটের ঝুঁকি ব্যবস্থাপনার নির্ণায়ক হিসাবে ব্যবহার করা যাইবে।

Customs Computerised Entry Processing Sy: The Customs Risk Management Commissionerate is authorized to collect relevant data from the customs computer system for the purposes of risk management.
Customs Risk Management Commissionerate: This body is responsible for collecting risk-related data from the customs computer system and verifying information gathered from domestic or international sources, including informants.
It utilizes analyzed and verified data as criteria for risk management.

It integrates data regarding irregularities found in import or export consignments from the Customs Intelligence and Investigation Directorate or any customs station into its risk management criteria.
Customs Intelligence and Investigation D: This directorate provides data on irregularities detected in import or export consignments to the Customs Risk Management Commissionerate for use in risk management analysis.
Customs Station: Any customs station in Bangladesh is authorized to report irregularities discovered during post-clearance inspection to the Customs Risk Management Commissionerate for risk analysis purposes.

Automated System for Customs Data: The system uses selectivities to determine processing channels for cargo and passengers. It establishes an automated risk management framework to evaluate shipment risks based on pre-defined indicators.

The system classifies consignments into red, yellow, blue, and green lanes, and passengers into red and green channels for customs clearance. It also assigns risk scores based on the degree of similarity to established risk indicators.

It creates profiles for importers, exporters, agents, and passengers to identify potential risks through data processing. The system incorporates historical records, intelligence data, and advanced analytical methods to refine its risk assessment indicators.
Data Analytics: Advanced data analytics, machine learning, and artificial intelligence are utilized to process customs documentation and records. These methodologies serve as the technical foundation for identifying and setting risk indicators within the automated management framework.
Manifest Data: Consignment information and related data are compared against established risk indicators to determine potential security or compliance threats during the customs clearance process.

১০। সিলেক্টভিটি পদ্ধতি।—(১) এই বিধিমালায় নির্দেশিত কার্যপদ্ধতি ও সময় সময় বোর্ড কর্তৃক জারীকৃত ঝুঁকি ব্যবস্থাপনা সম্পর্কিত নির্দেশনা অনুযায়ী স্বয়ংক্রিয় ঝুঁকি ব্যবস্থাপনা পদ্ধতি পরিচালিত হইবে।
(২) ঝুঁকি ব্যবস্থাপনার সার্বিক প্রক্রিয়ািদর ব্যবস্থাপনার বিষয়ে কাস্টমস রিস্ক ম্যানেজমেন্ট কমিশনারেট একটি আদর্শ পরিচালন পদ্ধতি বা Standard Operating Procedure (এসওপি) প্রণয়ন করিবে যাহা গোপনীয় দলিল হিসেবে বিবেচিত হইবে এবং উহার ভিত্তিতে দৈনন্দিন ঝুঁকি ব্যবস্থাপনা কার্যক্রম পরিচালিত হইবে।
(৩) স্বয়ংক্রিয় ঝুঁকি ব্যবস্থাপনা সম্ভাব্য ঝুঁকি নির্দেশক, প্রোফাইল, ঝুঁকি রেজিস্টার গোপনীয় হিসেবে বিবেচিত হইবে।

Risk Analysis: The automated risk management system operates in accordance with the procedures outlined in these rules and the guidelines issued by the National Board of Revenue.
The automated risk management system treats risk indicators, risk profiles, and risk registers as confidential information.
National Board of Revenue: The Board is empowered to issue ongoing instructions and guidelines regarding the management of risk for the customs authorities.
Customs Risk Management Commissionerate: This authority is responsible for formulating a Standard Operating Procedure that serves as the basis for daily customs risk management activities.
The Standard Operating Procedure formulated by this commissionerate is classified as a confidential document.
Standard Operating Procedure: This document governs daily risk management operations and must be maintained as a confidential record.

processed_clauses.resolved_text: ১১। ঝুঁকি ব্যবস্থাপনা পদ্ধতি মডেল এবং ঝুঁকি রেজিস্টার।—সিআরএমসি ওয়ার্ল্ড কাস্টমস অর্গানাইজেশনের ঝুঁকি ব্যবস্থাপনা মডেল বা ইন্টারন্যাশনাল বেস্ট প্র্যাকটিস বা বোর্ড কর্তৃক অনুমোদিত কোনো ঝুঁকি ব্যবস্থাপনা মডেল অনুসরণ ও ব্যবহার করিতে পারিবে এবং তদানুযায়ী ঝুঁকি রেজিস্টার এবং ঝুঁকি মূল্যায়ন ডাটাবেস প্রস্তুত করিতে পারিবে।

Customs Risk Management Committee: The committee is authorized to utilize the World Customs Organization risk management model or other internationally recognized best practices.
The committee is empowered to prepare and maintain a risk register and a risk assessment database based on approved risk management models.
The committee may adopt any risk management model that has been formally approved by the National Board of Revenue.
National Board of Revenue: The board serves as the governing authority responsible for approving the risk management models used within the customs risk management framework.
Risk Management Model: This is the structural framework used by the customs authorities to identify and mitigate risks during customs operations.
The model must be based on either World Customs Organization standards, international best practices, or specific models approved by the National Board of Revenue.
Risk Register and Risk Assessment Databa: These are mandatory components of the risk management system that must be developed and maintained to record and analyze operational risk data.

processed_clauses.resolved_text: ১২। বার্ষিক মূল্যায়ন প্রতিবেদন।—সিলেক্টভিটি পদ্ধতির কার্যকারিতা পরিবীক্ষণের লক্ষ্যে সিআরএমসি কাস্টমস কম্পিউটার সিস্টেম অথবা এআরএমএস অথবা সিলেক্টভিটি পদ্ধতির কার্যকারিতা এবং উহার ভিত্তিতে গৃহীত ঝুঁকি নিরসন ব্যবস্থার ফলাফল চিহ্নিত করিতে সক্ষম এমন কোনো সিস্টেমে রক্ষিত তথ্য-উপাত্ত হইতে বার্ষিক মূল্যায়ন প্রতিবেদন তৈরী করিবে।

Customs Risk Management Committee: The committee is responsible for preparing an annual assessment report to monitor the effectiveness of the selectivity method.
Customs Computerised Entry Processing Sy: This system serves as a data source for extracting information required for the production of the annual assessment report regarding risk management activities.
Selectivity Method: The effectiveness of this method and the outcomes of the risk mitigation measures derived from it must be analyzed for the annual assessment report.
